arxiv-2003-02285.title: Device-Independent Certification of Genuinely Entangled Subspaces
arxiv-2003-02285.creator: Flavio Baccari, Remigiusz Augusiak, Ivan Šupić, Antonio Acín
arxiv-2003-02285.description: Abstract Self-testing is a procedure for characterising quantum resources with the minimal level of trust. Up to now it has been used as a device-independent certification tool for particular quantum measurements, channels and pure entangled states. In this work we introduce the concept of self-testing more general entanglement structures.

arxiv-2104-04780.title: Spin-Hall nanooscillator based on an antiferromagnetic domain wall.
arxiv-2104-04780.creator: R.V. Ovcharov, E. G. Galkina, B.A. Ivanov, R.S. Khymyn
arxiv-2104-04780.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by R.V. Ovcharov, E. G. Galkina, B.A. Ivanov, R.S. Khymyn. We propose here a high-frequency spin-Hall nano-oscillator based on a simple magnetic texture, such as a domain wall, located in an antiferromagnet with an easy-axis anisotropy type.

arxiv-2403-19267.title: MineLand: Simulating Large-Scale Multi-Agent Interactions with Limited Multimodal Senses and Physical Needs
arxiv-2403-19267.creator: Xianhao Yu Jiaqi Fu Renjia Deng Wenjuan Han
arxiv-2403-19267.description: Abstract While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) hold promise for tasks requiring extensive collaboration, traditional multi-agent simulators have facilitated rich explorations of an interactive artificial society that reflects collective behavior. However, these existing simulators face significant limitations. Firstly, they struggle with handling large numbers of agents due to high resource demands.

arxiv-2407-17539.title: Automated transport separation using the neural shifted proper orthogonal decomposition.
arxiv-2407-17539.creator: Beata Zorawski 1, Shubhaditya Burela 1, Philipp Krah 2, Arthur Marmin 2 and Kai Schneider 2
arxiv-2407-17539.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Beata Zorawski 1, Shubhaditya Burela 1, Philipp Krah 2, Arthur Marmin 2 and Kai Schneider 2. This paper presents a neural network-based methodology for the decomposition of transport-dominated fields using the shifted proper orthogonal decomposition (sPOD). Classical sPOD methods typically require an a priori knowledge of the transport operators to determine the co-moving fields. However, in many real-life problems, such knowledge is difficult or even impossible to obtain, limiting the applicability and benefits of the sPOD.

arxiv-2410-06920.title: To Be or Not to Be (in the EU): Measurement of Discrepancies Presented in Cookie Paywalls
arxiv-2410-06920.creator: Andreas Stenwreth * 1 , Simon Täng * 1 and Victor Morel 1 1 Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Chalmers University of Technology, Gothenburg, Sweden { andstenw, simonta, morelv } @chalmers.se
arxiv-2410-06920.description: Abstract Cookie paywalls allow visitors to access the content of a website only after making a choice between paying a fee (paying option) or accepting tracking (cookie option). The practice has been studied in previous research in regard to its prevalence and legal standing, but the effects of the clients’ device and geographic location remain unexplored.

arxiv-2411-03045.title: Anisotropic DLVO-like interaction for charge patchiness in colloids and proteins
arxiv-2411-03045.creator: Andraž Gnidovec, Emanuele Locatelli, Simon Čopar, Anže Božič, Emanuela Bianchi
arxiv-2411-03045.description: Abstract The behaviour and stability of soft and biological matter depend significantly on electrostatic interactions, as particles such as proteins and colloids acquire a charge when dispersed in an electrolytic solution. A typical simplification used to understand bulk phenomena involving electrostatic interactions is the isotropy of the charge on the particles.

arxiv-2411-08457.title: Wave Topology of Stellar Inertial Oscillations
arxiv-2411-08457.creator: Armand Leclerc, Guillaume Laibe, Nicolas Perez
arxiv-2411-08457.description: Abstract Inertial waves in convective regions of stars exhibit topological properties linked to a Chern number of 1 1 . The first of these is a unique, unidirectional, prograde oscillation mode within the cavity, which propagates at arbitrarily low frequencies for moderate azimuthal wavenumbers.

arxiv-2412-15849.title: Impact of reionization history on constraining primordial gravitational waves in future all-sky cosmic microwave background experiments
arxiv-2412-15849.creator: Hanchun Jiang, Toshiya Namikawa
arxiv-2412-15849.description: Abstract We explore the impact of the reionization history on examining the shape of the power spectrum of the primordial gravitational waves (PGWs) with the cosmic microwave background (CMB) polarization. The large-scale CMB generated from the reionization epoch is important in probing the PGWs from all-sky experiments, such as LiteBIRD. The reionization model has been constrained by several astrophysical observations.

arxiv-2501-17815.title: A machine-learning study of phase transitions in Ising, Blume-Capel, and Ising-metamagnet models
arxiv-2501-17815.creator: Vasanth Kumar Babu, Rahul Pandit
arxiv-2501-17815.description: Abstract We combine machine-learning (ML) techniques with Monte Carlo (MC) simulations and finite-size scaling (FSS) to study continuous and first-order phase transitions in Ising, Blume-Capel, and Ising-metamagnet spin models. We go beyond earlier studies that had concentrated on obtaining the correlation-length exponent ν \nu .

arxiv-2601-17759.title: Extended Self-similarity in Multimode Optical Fiber Speckles
arxiv-2601-17759.creator: Mengxin Wu, Ziye Chen, Guang Yang, Mingshu Zhao
arxiv-2601-17759.description: Abstract Extended Self-Similarity (ESS) is a widely used tool for uncovering universal power-law scaling in systems dominated by nonlinear interactions. This work demonstrates that ESS scaling can also emerge in a system governed by purely linear physics: the propagation of coherent light in a multimode fiber. The system produces complex speckle patterns arising solely from deterministic linear mode interference.

arxiv-2601-21534.title: Electoral Polls and Economic Uncertainty: an Analysis of the Last Two U.S. Presidential Elections Thanks: Corresponding author. Email: dlacava@unime.it Thanks: Edoardo Otranto gratefully acknowledges the Italian PRIN 2022 grant (20223725WE) “Methodological and computational issues in large-scale ser
arxiv-2601-21534.creator: Giampiero M. Gallo
arxiv-2601-21534.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Giampiero M. Gallo. This paper examines the dynamic relationship between electoral polls and indicators of economic and financial uncertainty during the last two U.S. presidential elections (2020 and 2024). Using daily polling data on Donald Trump and measures such as the Aruoba-Diebold-Scotti Business Conditions Index, the 5-year Breakeven Inflation Rate, the Trade Policy Uncertainty index, and the VIX, we estimate conditional correlation models to capture time-varying interactions.

britannica-1911-escher-von-der-linth-arn.title: Escher von der Linth, Arnold (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-escher-von-der-linth-arn.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-escher-von-der-linth-arn.description: Article 'Escher von der Linth, Arnold' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 9), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. geologist, the son of Hans Conrad Escher (1767–1823), was born at Zürich on the 8th of June 1807. In 1856 he became professor of geology at the École Polytechnique at Zürich. His researches led him to be regarded as one of the founders of Swiss geology. Studer he produced (1852–1853) the first elaborate geological map of Switzerland.

pmc-10608246.title: Optic Nerve Sheath Diameter: A Cross-Sectional Study of Ultrasonographic Measurement in Healthy Black South African Adults
pmc-10608246.creator: Lindy Trollip, Kerry Alberto, Aubrey Makgotloe, Akio Oishi, Livio Vitiello
pmc-10608246.description: Ultrasonographic optic nerve sheath diameter (ONSD) measurement is an accurate, portable, and non-invasive method of detecting raised intracranial pressure that can also reflect dynamic, real-time changes in intracranial pressure fluctuations. Various studies have shown the mean range of ONSD to vary greatly across different population groups. This study aimed to determine the mean ONSD in healthy Black South African adults.

pmc-11458420.title: Signal peptide exchange alters HIV-1 envelope antigenicity and immunogenicity
pmc-11458420.creator: Chitra Upadhyay, Priyanka Rao, Mohammad Amin Behzadi, Roya Feyznezhad, Gregory S. Lambert, Rajnish Kumar, Madhu Kumar, Weiming Yang, Xunqing Jiang, Christina C. Luo, Arthur Nadas, James Arthos, Xiang-Peng Kong, Hui Zhang, Catarina E. Hioe, J. Andrew Duty
pmc-11458420.description: IntroductionHIV-1 envelope (Env) is the key target for antibodies (Abs) against the virus and thus an important HIV-1 vaccine component. Env is synthesized from a gp160 precursor with a signal peptide (SP) at its N-terminus. This study investigated the influence of the SP on Env antigenicity and immunogenicity.

pmc-11490895.title: Thoughts and opinions about fertility preservation and family building from the transgender community—an interview-based approach
pmc-11490895.creator: Zachary W Walker, Katelin McDilda, Andrea Lanes, Randi Goldman, Elizabeth S Ginsburg, Iris Insogna
pmc-11490895.description: BackgroundWhen considering the significant prevalence of transgender and gender nonconforming individuals, it is imperative that physicians work to understand the unique needs of this population including paths to family building and fertility preservation.ObjectiveTo understand the thoughts and opinions about fertility preservation and family building within the transgender community.Study designSurvey-based study and qualitative study at a single, large hospital-affiliated fertility center.

pmc-11493933.title: Clinical implementation of advanced respiratory monitoring with esophageal pressure and electrical impedance tomography: results from an international survey and focus group discussion
pmc-11493933.creator: Jantine J Wisse, Gaetano Scaramuzzo, Mariangela Pellegrini, Leo Heunks, Thomas Piraino, Peter Somhorst, Laurent Brochard, Tommaso Mauri, Erwin Ista, Annemijn H Jonkman
pmc-11493933.description: BackgroundPopularity of electrical impedance tomography (EIT) and esophageal pressure (Pes) monitoring in the ICU is increasing, but there is uncertainty regarding their bedside use within a personalized ventilation strategy. We aimed to gather insights about the current experiences and perceived role of these physiological monitoring techniques, and to identify barriers and facilitators/solutions for EIT and Pes implementation.

pmc-11600391.title: Resolving Heterogeneity in CO2 Uptake Potential in the Greenland Coastal Ocean
pmc-11600391.creator: Henry C. Henson, Mikael Sejr, Lorenz Meire, Lise Lotte Sørensen, Mie H. S. Winding, Johnna M. Holding
pmc-11600391.description: The oceans play a pivotal role in mitigating climate change by sequestering approximately 25% of annually emitted carbon dioxide (CO2). High‐latitude oceans, especially the Arctic continental shelves, emerge as crucial CO2 sinks due to their cold, low saline, and highly productive ecosystems. However, these heterogeneous regions remain inadequately understood, hindering accurate assessments of their carbon dynamics.

pmc-11725065.title: Acceptability of interactive post-endodontic restoration decision making application among undergraduate dental students
pmc-11725065.creator: Jia Qing Soo, Xing Yong Wong, Naveen Chhabra, Liang Lin Seow, Shekhar Bhatia
pmc-11725065.description: Background/PurposeSelecting an appropriate coronal restoration after root canal treatment requires careful consideration, however, there is a lack of established web-based tool that is based on clear guidelines for suitable post-endodontic restorations. Hence, we aimed to design and determine the acceptability of an interactive application to aid the decision making process for post-endodontic restoration among the undergraduate dental students.

pmc-12425755.title: Association of pan-immune-inflammation value and atherogenic index of plasma with chronic coronary syndrome in non-alcoholic fatty liver disease patients
pmc-12425755.creator: Bing Yu, Jianqi Zhao, Wenjing Zhang, Leigang Wang, Xin Zheng, Xin Li, Zhong Yao, Yao Sun, Zhaoyu Ren, Bin Liang
pmc-12425755.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundNon-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is linked to a higher risk of cardiovascular disease, particularly chronic coronary syndrome (CCS). However, reliable biomarkers for early CCS risk stratification in NAFLD patients remain lacking. This study aims to assess the pan-immune-inflammation value (PIV) and atherogenic index of plasma (AIP) for CCS in NAFLD patients and to construct a practical tool for personalized risk assessment.MethodsThis retrospective study included 459 NAFLD patients undergoing coronary angiography.

pmc-12521778.title: Validity, safety, usability, and user experience of virtual reality gamified home-based exercises in stroke
pmc-12521778.creator: Hatem Lazem, David Harris, Abi Hall, Maedeh Mansoubi, Rodrigo Garcia Pontes, Carlos Bandeira de Mello Monteiro, Luciano Vieira de Araújo, Sarah E Lamb, Helen Dawes
pmc-12521778.description: ObjectiveThis study adopted a novel approach to exploring the content validity, safety, usability, and user experiences of different games for telerehabilitation purposes from the perspective of physiotherapists and stroke survivors.DesignA cross-sectional content validity and usability study.SettingLab and online.Participants23 participants were recruited; 11 neuro-physiotherapists and 12 chronic stroke survivors.OutcomesContent validity and safety were assessed using a bespoke state evaluation questionnaire.

pmc-12564760.title: The Physicochemical, Sensory, and Functional Properties of Yogurt Containing Millet and Milk
pmc-12564760.creator: Hui Wang, Yingyu Zhang, Yuxuan Han, Jiaxin Hou, Yingjun Zuo, Yan Li, Hua Wu
pmc-12564760.description: With growing consumer demand for functional dairy products, developing yogurts enriched with natural bioactive ingredients has become a research focus. Millet, a traditional cereal rich in polyphenols and dietary fiber, remains understudied in fermented dairy applications. This study evaluated the physicochemical properties, sensory quality, and functional activities of yogurt co-fermented with millet.

pmc-12610568.title: Comprehensive Oxidative Stress Profiling and Clinical Correlates in Spondyloarthritis: The Role of Glutathione Peroxidase and Modifiable Lifestyle Factors
pmc-12610568.creator: Rim Dhahri, Insaf Fenniche, Ismail Dergaa, Halil İbrahim Ceylan, Nicola Luigi Bragazzi, Lobna Ben Ammar, Hiba Ben Ayed, Ba Afif, Chakib Mazigh, Imène Gharsallah, Chang-Hee Suh
pmc-12610568.description: Background: Oxidative stress represents a key pathogenic factor in spondyloarthritis (SpA), yet its comprehensive assessment remains underutilized in routine clinical practice. Objectives: We evaluated oxidative stress biomarker profiles in SpA patients to determine associations with disease activity, systemic inflammation, structural damage, lifestyle factors, and therapeutic responses for practical clinical implementation.

pmc-13368099.title: How North Carolina is Using Opioid Settlement Funds to Reduce Overdose Deaths
pmc-13368099.creator: Cecilia Gonzales, Katherine Gora Combs, Adams Sibley, Stephen W. Marshall
pmc-13368099.description: North Carolina has made progress towards the Healthy North Carolina 2030 initiative to reduce drug overdose rates. Opioid settlement funds have made this progress possible, but more time and work are needed for lasting change. Introduction Drug overdose continues to be one of the fundamental public health challenges of our time, in North Carolina and nationally.

pmc-13464245.title: Ivabradine in a Neonate With Severe Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
pmc-13464245.creator: Yaa S. Karikari, Genevieve Baxter, Hugo R. Martinez, Kaitlin Ryan, Karine Guerrier
pmc-13464245.description: BackgroundHypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) affects approximately 20% of patients with Noonan syndrome and contributes significantly to mortality, particularly in neonates with severe HCM and left ventricular outflow tract obstruction, where controlling heart rate (HR) and maintaining systemic vascular resistance can be challenging.

pmc-13548617.title: A qualitative study on aviophobia and coping strategies
pmc-13548617.creator: Eylül Eyiz, Kübra Nur Kırhan, Sevdiye Kemik Polat, Mustafa Aslan

pmc-13611755.title: OSI Stack Redesign for Quantum Networks: Requirements, Technologies, Challenges, and Future Directions
pmc-13611755.creator: Shakil Ahmed, Yehia Osman, Luke Cue, Ibrahim Almazyad, Nasser S. Albalawi, Muhammad Kamran Saeed, Ashfaq Khokhar
pmc-13611755.description: Quantum communication is emerging as a foundation for next-generation networks, offering unprecedented capabilities in security, entanglement-based connectivity, and distributed computation. However, the classical Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model, designed for deterministic, error-tolerant systems, is incompatible with quantum phenomena such as decoherence, probabilistic entanglement, and the no-cloning theorem.
